physicalNotes: Radius 1137 +/- 372 solar radii from Jencson et al. (2022), ApJ 930, 81, section 4.4.1: log(L/L_sun) = 5.60 for the best-fitting model (5.35 to 5.75 for the models that fit well, at the paper's distance modulus of M51, 29.67) and T_eff = 4300 K (3700 to 4700 K), through L = 4 pi R^2 sigma T^4 with the nominal solar 5772 K (IAU 2015 Resolution B3, Prsa et al. 2016, arXiv:1605.09788); the paper prints no radius, and no measurement of this star's size exists (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4357/ac626c): 791,010,900 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4300 +/- 500 K from Jencson et al. (2022), ApJ 930, 81, section 4.4.1: the model that best fits the star's light before its 2019 dimming has T_eff = 4300 K; the models that fit well span 3700 to 4700 K (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4357/ac626c). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

sources.position: Jencson et al. (2022), ApJ 930, 81, section 4.1 (13:29:56.16 +47:11:47.8); SIMBAD holds that position, from 2022ApJ...930...81J (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=NAME%20M51-DS1), SIMBAD basic row main_id = NAME M51-DS1: ra 202.484, dec 47.1966111111111, from the archived row src/objects/m51-ds1/source/photometry/catalogue-row.tsv; SIMBAD names it NAME M51-DS1
sources.distance: Placed in Whirlpool Galaxy as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 8,341,566 pc (src/objects/m51-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 8,340,652 pc, inclination 32.6 deg, line of nodes 163 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 47404: distance modulus 29.606 ± 0.079 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94): 8341566 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star
sources.properMotion: basic row main_id = NAME M51-DS1 measures no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 8,341,566 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 39,543 km/s across the sky)
sources.radialVelocity: SIMBAD's radial velocity of Whirlpool Galaxy, the star's galaxy, from 2022ApJS..261....6K; the star's own motion within the galaxy is not measured (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022ApJS..261....6K/abstract)
